about: The improvement registry: every candidate improvement a course shows, traced to its source and its decision. Before adding an item, a run searches this file, FEATURES.md and review/port-queue.md for it and links an existing entry instead of adding a duplicate. Statuses: discovered, evaluating, proposed, implementing, testing, awaiting-approval, adopted, deferred, rejected. kind: course-specific, optional-feature, core-change, skill-guidance. severity (optional): critical (progress loss, a live site broken), high, normal. A feature in use is not evidence that it helps learning: evidence names what was observed.
